original: yāvan na grasyate rogair yāvan nābhyeti te jarā
yāvan na kṣīyate vāyus tāvat kalyāṇam ācara ||1
ko bandhur mama kasyāham ity ātmānaṃ vicintayet ||2
puruṣās tīrtham icchanti kiṃ tirthaiḥ kleśakāraṇaiḥ
idaṃ tīrtham idaṃ tīrtham iti jñātvā bhramante ye
jñānadhyānavihīnās te sati tīrthaṃ svam eva hi ||4
kenāpi dṛśyate naiva svātmāyaṃ paśyato haraḥ ||5
lokair vilokyate cauro gate svalpe 'pi vastuni
sarvasvaharam ātmānaṃ manāk paśyanti no jaḍāḥ ||6
aprasannaḥ punar ayaṃ durgatiḥ syād asaṃśayam ||8
vasann atraiva dehe 'sau devo draṣṭuṃ na śakyate ||9
ṣaṭcakravat tu pīṭhādi sarvaṃ tyaktā mumukṣubhiḥ | [tyaktvā?]
ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ na jalaṃ tīrtham ucyate
svātmajñānena yac chaucaṃ tac chaucaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ||18
pradhānaṃ sarvavidvānāṃ prāpyate hy amṛtaṃ tataḥ ||18
tapobhir dustapais taptair vratais tais taiś ca puṣkaraiḥ
ātmajñānaṃ vinā mokṣo na bhaved yogīnām api ||20
ātmāyaṃ jñāyate tena tasya janma vidyate ||21
śaṅkaro vā jineśo vā yo yasyābhimataḥ sadā
eka eva prabhuḥ śānto nirvāṇastho vilokyate ||23
paramātmā paraṃ jyotiḥ paraṃ brahma parāt paraḥ ||28
achedyaś cāpy abhedyaś ca nirlepo nirmalaprabhuḥ ||29
eko 'py anekarūpaś ca sthūlasūkṣmo laghur guruḥ
brāhmaṇair lakṣyate brahmā viṣṇuḥ pītāṃ varais tathā
rudras tapasvibhir dṛṣṭa eṣa eva nirañjanaḥ ||32
jinendro jalpyate jainair buddhaḥ kṛtvā sa saugataiḥ
kaulikaiḥ kola ākhyātaḥ sa evāyaṃ sanātanaḥ ||33
sa tathā darśanaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ khyāta eko 'py anekadhā ||34
bhāvabhedān na ma sthanti darśanāny ekavartmanā
ekatrāpi sthitāḥ kārye pañcaite viṣayā yathā ||36
niṣakalo nirmamaḥ śāntaḥ sarvajñaḥ sukhadaḥ prabhuḥ
sa eva bhagavān eko devo jñeyo nirañjanaḥ ||37
pūjayet taṃ tato yogī bhāvaṃ puṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||41
bhaktisthale viśāle ca vaśyaṃ kṛtvā sthiraṃ manaḥ
uttārayet prabhoḥ puṇyam ārārtrikam iti kramāt ||43
paramātmasvarūpaṃ taṃ svam ātmā cainaṃ vicintayet ||43
saṃyamo niyamaś caiva karaṇaṃ ca tṛtīyakaṃ
dhyānaṃ cetīha yogasya jñeyam aṣṭāṅgakaṃ budhaiḥ
pūrṇāṅgakriyamāṇas tu muktaye syād asau satām ||51
taddharmataddharmas tadvrataṃ dhyānaṃ tat ta yo yoga eva saḥ | [tat tat ?]
sa eva hi padāroho na yatra kliśyate manaḥ ||52
niyuñjita sadā cittaṃ sabhāve bhāvanāṃ kuru
pade tatra gato yogī na punar janmatāṃ vrajet ||54
jñeyaṃ sarvapadātītaṃ jñānaṃ ca mana ucyate
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ samaṃ kuryān nānyo mokṣapathaḥ punaḥ ||55
bhruvopari mano nītvā tat paraṃ cāvalokyate
parāt parataraṃ tac ca ta chukṣmaṃ tan nirañjanaṃ ||56|| [tac chūkṣmaṃ ?]
parācinaṃ padaṃ jñeyaṃ yogibhis tan nirañjanaṃ ||60
pavano mriyate yatra mano yatra vilīyate
unmanībhāvam āyātaṃ labhate tat padaṃ kramāt ||62
yadā yāty unmatibhāvaṃ tadā tat paramaṃ padaṃ ||63
dhyātṛ dhyāno bhayābhāvo dhyeyanaikyaṃ padā vrajet
athātaḥ procyate tattvaṃ durjñeyaṃ mahatām api ||65
rātrau suptena mūkena labdhaḥ svapno 'tra kena cit
na brūte sno pi mūkas tu tena svapno na budhyate ||66
yo mūko yādṛśī rātri svapno 'pi prājñayā dṛśaḥ
phalaṃ ca yādṛśaṃ tasya śṛṇu saumya tadā darāt ||67
avidyā rātri supte na citta mūkena yoginā
kṛtas tena sthiro bhāva parabrahmaṇi yoginā
sadā svapnārthaḥ kathitaḥ prājñaḥ yogayuktyā tavāgrataḥ ||71
na kiṃ cic cintayec cittam unmanībhāvasaṅgataṃ
uktās tasyaiva rohārthaṃ prāsāde padikaṃ yathā ||72
kādṛśo 'smi kva gantāsmi kiṃ karomi smarāmi kiṃ
iti yogī na jānāti laye līno nirañjane ||73
aniruddhair indriyād vai dhyānād avyāvartate manaḥ ||74
śamaṃ nīteṣu teṣv atra kaṣāyeṣv indriyeṣv api
vaśyaṃ yena kṛtaṃ tasya bhaved vaśyaṃ jagatrayaṃ ||77
yac chubhaṃ karmakatṛtvaṃ tat kuryān manasā saha
manas tulyaṃ phalaṃ yasmāt śūnye śūnyaṃ bhavet punaḥ ||78
kṛtvābhyāso yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ vidhyati tanmanā
ekacittas tathā yogī vāñchitaṃ karma sādhayet ||79
tasmād apy uttamaṃ sāraṃ pavitraṃ karmanāśanaṃ
janma lakṣyair vratair ugrair yatraiva kṣīyate kva cit
manaḥ śamarase magnaṃ tat karma kṣayayet kṣaṇāt ||81
sā siddhiḥ syāt satāṃ yāno sarvatīrthāvagāhane ||82
yogaṃ yogaṃ prakurvāṇā saṃbhrāmanti diśo diśo ||83
saṃprāptā paramaṃ brahma sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ ||84
mokṣārthaṃ samatāṃ yāti samudraṃ sarito yathā ||85|| [yānti ?]
atītaṃ ca bhaviṣyac ca yan na śocati mānasaṃ
gate śoko na yasyāstī na ca harṣaḥ samāgate
yat prasarpati loke 'smin śāstraṃ kukavibhi kṛtaṃ
yathā rātrau tame mūḍhā naiva paśyanti jantavaḥ
iti jñātvā budhair nityaṃ svātmane hitavāñchayā
iti jñātvā budhair nityaṃ dūratas tyājyā na śrotavyā kadā cana ||94
rajas tamaś ca santyajya sattvam ekaṃ samāśrayet ||96
santāṃ dhyānamaye saudhe sattvastambho dṛdho mataḥ ||98
lakṣam ekaṃ kathaṃ tiṣṭhet tasmin karma rajo malaḥ ||101
na laget padmini patre yathā toyaṃ svabhāvataḥ
sphaṭiko malino na syāt rajasā chādito yathā
na lipyate tathā pāpair ātmā saddhyānam āśritaḥ ||103
rūpātītaṃ nirākāraṃ dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ tato niśaṃ ||105
granthānn abhyasya tattvārthaṃ tattvajñāne punaḥ sudhīḥ
palālam iva dhyānārthaṃ tyajed granthān śeṣataḥ ||106
kṣīyante yāni kālena kiṃ taiḥ kartavyam akṣaraiḥ
yāvan no nakṣaraprāptaṃ tāvan mokṣasukhaṃ kutaḥ ||107
asminn eva bhave saumya vyomarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ
vibhaktaḥ saṃyamādyaṅgaiḥ so 'pi syād aṣṭadhā punaḥ ||112
layaṃ praṇavanādasya yas taṃ vetti sa yogavit ||116
ghaṇṭānāde yathā prāpte praśāmyan madhuro bhavet
sa nādo 'nāhatas tena na nādo vyaktisaṃbhavaḥ ||118
yac cittaṃ sahajāvasthaṃ sa nādas tena bhidyate ||120
tāvad eveṅdriyāṇi syuḥ kaṣāyās tāvad eva hi
anāhate mano nāde yāval līnaṃ na yoginaḥ ||121
tamaḥ sūryodayeneva tat sarvaṃ naśyati kṣaṇāt ||123
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca sākāraṃ śubhadhyānam iti sphutaṃ
śarīraṃ sakalaṃ tyaktvā brahmadvāre sthiraṃ manaḥ
kriyate yadi tat sukṣmaṃ nirākāram ihocyate ||126
tasmād apy ūrdhvagaṃ brahma dvādaśānte tathā smṛtaṃ ||130
ruddhā yogi kaṣāyaprasaram aticalān indriyān svān niyamya
tyaktvā vā saṅgam anyaṃ paramapadasukhaprāptaye baddhabuddhiḥ
kṛtvā cittaṃ sthiraṃ svaṃ śamarasakalitaṃ sattvaṃ ālambya bāḍhaṃ
dhyānaṃ dhyātuṃ yateta pratidinam amalaṃ śuddhadharmāvitaṇḍaḥ ||132
chitvā saṃsṛtipāśam antarabalaṃ jitvātha mohādikaṃ dīkṣāṃ
mokṣakarīṃ prapadya sa budhaḥ pārśvaprabhor udyataḥ
brahmajñānalayena kevalamayaṃ jñānaṃ samutpādya ca prāyan
ity etāni vratāny atra saṁyamaḥ pañcadhā smṛtaḥ ||134
śaucaṃ tapaś ca santoṣaḥ svādhyāyo devatāsmṛtiḥ
niyamaḥ pañcadhā jñeyaḥ karaṇaṃ punar āsanaṃ ||135
sthūle vā yadi vā sūkṣme sākāre ca nirākṛtau
evaṃ yogo bhaved yogair aṣṭadhā saṃyamādibhiḥ
divi bhūmau tathā kāśe bahir antaś ca yo vibhūḥ
yo vibhāty eva bhāsātmā tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ ||140
nāhaṃ baddho vimuktaś ca iti yasyāsti niścayaḥ
nānyaṃ tato jñāno mūrkhaḥ so 'smin śāstre 'dhikāravān ||141
